# $K$-Nearest Neighbors Classification

## Predict `default` using balance

- Prepare the training and test data
    ```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
    library(tidyverse)
    library(ISLR)
    library(caret)
    default_tr <- Default[1:3000, ]
    default_te <- Default[-(1:3000), ]
    ```
- Run KNN on training data using $K=5$.
    ```{r class.source="bg-danger"}
    fit_knn <- knn3(default ~ balance, data = default_tr, k = 5)
    pred_knn <- predict(fit_knn, newdata = default_tr, type = "class")
    mean(pred_knn != default_tr$default)
    pred_knn <- predict(fit_knn, newdata = default_te, type = "class")
    mean(pred_knn != default_te$default)
    ```

- Run KNN on training data with varying $K$ values
    ```{r, echo = TRUE, class.source="bg-danger"}
    k_seq <- seq(from = 1, to = 300, by = 10)
    train_error_seq <- test_error_seq <- NULL
    for(k_ind in seq_along(k_seq)){
      k <- k_seq[k_ind]
      fit_knn <- knn3(default ~ balance, data = default_tr, k = k)
      pred_knn <- predict(fit_knn, newdata = default_tr, type = "class")
      train_error_seq[k_ind] <- mean(pred_knn != default_tr$default)
      pred_knn <- predict(fit_knn, newdata = default_te, type = "class")
      test_error_seq[k_ind] <- mean(pred_knn != default_te$default)
    }
    knn_re <- rbind(data.frame(K = k_seq, error = train_error_seq, type = "train"),
                    data.frame(K = k_seq, error = test_error_seq, type = "test"))
    ggplot(knn_re, mapping = aes(x = K, y = error, color = type)) +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1)
    ```

## Importance of standardization before applying KNN

```{r, echo=TRUE}
library(MASS)
n <- 100
set.seed(0)
mu1 <- c(0, 2)
mu2 <- c(5, 2)
Sigma <- matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), 2, 2)
x1 <- mvrnorm(n, mu1, Sigma)
x2 <- mvrnorm(n, mu2, Sigma)
dat_tr <- rbind(data.frame(v1 = x1[, 1]/50, v2 = x1[, 2], class = "blue"),
             data.frame(v1 = x2[, 1]/50, v2 = x2[, 2], class = "red"))

x1 <- mvrnorm(n, mu1, Sigma)
x2 <- mvrnorm(n, mu2, Sigma)
dat_te <- rbind(data.frame(v1 = x1[, 1]/50, v2 = x1[, 2], class = "blue"),
             data.frame(v1 = x2[, 1]/50, v2 = x2[, 2], class = "red"))
dat_tr$class <- as.factor(dat_tr$class)
dat_te$class <- as.factor(dat_te$class)
ggplot(dat_tr) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x = v1, y = v2, color = class)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) + xlim(c(-1,2.5))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
fit <- knn3(class ~ ., data = dat_tr, k = 5)
ypred <- predict(fit, newdata = dat_te, type = "class")
mean(ypred != dat_te$class)
```

## After standardization 

```{r, echo=TRUE, class.source="bg-danger"}
fit_std <- caret::preProcess(dat_tr, method = "scale")
dat_tr_std <- predict(fit_std, newdata = dat_tr)
dat_te_std <- predict(fit_std, newdata = dat_te)
ggplot(dat_tr_std) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x = v1, y = v2, color = class)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"))
fit <- knn3(class ~ ., data = dat_tr_std, k = 5)
ypred <- predict(fit, newdata = dat_te_std, type = "class")
mean(ypred != dat_te_std$class)
```

## Threshold for Binary Classification

- Fit the logistic regression model on the training data.
    ```{r, echo = TRUE, eval=TRUE, class.source="bg-danger"}
    fit_logi <- glm(default ~ balance + income, data = default_tr, family = "binomial");
    pred_train_prob <- predict(fit_logi, type = "response")
    
    class_labels <- levels(default_tr$default)
    c0 <- class_labels[1]    # "No"
    c1 <- class_labels[2]    # "Yes"
    pred_train_label <- ifelse(pred_train_prob > 0.5, c1, c0)
    
    # Confusion matrix/table
    confusion <- table(predicted = pred_train_label,
                       true = default_tr$default)
    confusion
    ```


- Let's compute FPR and TPR
    ```{r, echo = TRUE, class.source="bg-danger"}
    FP <- confusion["Yes", "No"]
    TP <- confusion["Yes", "Yes"]
    N <- sum(confusion[, "No"])
    P <- sum(confusion[, "Yes"])
    FPR <- FP/N
    TPR <- TP/P
    FPR
    TPR
    ```


## Adjusting the threshold


- Decrease the threshold
    ```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.asp=0.45}
    pred_train_label_2 <- ifelse(pred_train_prob > 0.1, c1, c0)
    table(predicted = pred_train_label_2, true = default_tr$default)
    ```
    ```{r,echo=TRUE}
    FPR <- 154/(2745 + 154)
    TPR <- 77/(24 + 77)
    FPR
    TPR
    ```

- Increase the threshold
    ```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, fig.asp=0.45}
    pred_train_label_2 <- ifelse(pred_train_prob > 0.7, c1, c0)
    table(predicted = pred_train_label_2, true = default_tr$default)
    ```
    ```{r,echo=TRUE}
    FPR <- 3/(2896 + 3)
    TPR <- 21/(80 + 21)
    FPR
    TPR
    ```

# Receiver Operating Characteristics (ROC) 


## Using the **pROC** package
```{r, echo = TRUE, class.source="bg-danger"}
    library(pROC)
    #define object to plot
    rocobj_logi <- roc(default_tr$default, pred_train_prob)
    #create ROC plot
    auc_logi <- auc(rocobj_logi)
    ggroc(rocobj_logi, size = 1) +
      ggtitle(paste("ROC using logistic regression with AUC value ", round(auc_logi, 3)))
```

## ROC curve by hand

```{r, echo = TRUE}
fit_logi <- glm(default ~ balance + income, data = default_tr, family='binomial');
pred_train_prob <- predict(fit_logi, type = 'response')
thre_seq <- sort(pred_train_prob)
fpr_seq <- tpr_seq <- NULL
for(thre_ind in seq_along(thre_seq)){
  thre <- thre_seq[thre_ind]
  pred_train_label <- ifelse(pred_train_prob > thre, "Yes", "No")
  FP <- sum(default_tr$default == "No" & pred_train_label == "Yes")
  TP <- sum(default_tr$default == "Yes" & pred_train_label == "Yes")
  N <- sum(default_tr$default == "No")
  P <- sum(default_tr$default == "Yes")
  fpr_seq[thre_ind] <- FP/N
  tpr_seq[thre_ind] <- TP/P
}
roc_dat <- data.frame(TPR = tpr_seq, FPR = fpr_seq)
ggplot(roc_dat) + geom_point(mapping = aes(x = FPR, y = TPR))
```

## Comparing different methods via `ggroc()`

```{r, class.source="bg-danger"}
library(MASS)
lda_fit <- lda(default ~ balance + income, data = default_tr)
lda_pred <- predict(lda_fit)$posterior[, 2]
rocobj_lda <- roc(default_tr$default, lda_pred)
auc_lda <- auc(rocobj_lda)
qda_fit <- qda(default ~ balance + income, data = default_tr)
qda_pred <- predict(qda_fit)$posterior[, 2]
rocobj_qda <- roc(default_tr$default, qda_pred)
auc_qda <- auc(rocobj_qda)
knn_fit <- knn3(default ~ balance + income, data = default_tr, k = 5,
                prob = TRUE)
knn_pred <- predict(knn_fit, newdata = default_tr, type = "prob")[ ,2]
rocobj_knn <- roc(default_tr$default, knn_pred)

auc_knn <- auc(rocobj_knn)
rocobjs <- list(Logistic = rocobj_logi, LDA = rocobj_lda, QDA = rocobj_qda,
                KNN = rocobj_knn)
methods_auc <- paste(c("Logistic", "LDA", "QDA","KNN"),
                     "AUC = ", 
                     round(c(auc_logi, auc_lda, auc_qda, auc_knn),3))
ggroc(rocobjs, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_color_discrete(labels = methods_auc)
```
